pitch_en: Deploys electrochemical grease traps removing oils from industrial kitchen wastewater and converting recovered grease into circular-economy feedstock.
pitch_es: Despliega trampas de grasa electroquímicas que eliminan aceites de aguas residuales industriales y convierten la grasa recuperada en materia prima de economía circular.
cta_pitch_en: G-TRAP and circular services for HORECA and industrial kitchens — less water contamination, recovered fats for downstream energy uses.
cta_pitch_es: G-TRAP y servicios circulares para cocinas HORECA e industriales — menos contaminación del agua, grasas recuperadas para usos energéticos.

portfolio.problem_head_en: Industrial kitchen wastewater carries fats and oils that contaminate rivers and treatment systems.
portfolio.problem_head_es: Las aguas residuales de cocinas industriales arrastran grasas y aceites que contaminan ríos y sistemas de tratamiento.
portfolio.problem_body_en: Restaurants, hotels, and food-service operators need practical grease management that meets environmental rules without slowing operations.
portfolio.problem_body_es: Restaurantes, hoteles y operadores de servicio de alimentos necesitan gestión de grasas práctica que cumpla normas ambientales sin frenar operaciones.

solution_steps.text_en: Automatic grease separation (G-TRAP) and collection services for industrial kitchens, with circular recovery of brown grease.
solution_steps.text_es: Separación automática de grasas (G-TRAP) y servicios de recolección para cocinas industriales, con recuperación circular de grasas.
